identification: Tub of six unsigned modern craft/textile artworks: three square panels of cut, dyed velvet or plush fabric worked in chevron/radiating patterns (one gold, one purple-black, one red-black with pale centre) stitched onto black felt boards; two padded cream felt squares on dark board each with a small embroidered or printed body study (one torso/breasts, one female genitalia on a patterned ground); one painted board in red and green blocks. Student or hobby textile art, probably from one maker. Estimate 10-20.

entries.note: 1970s Australiana felt textile art, framed wildflowers. Unsigned/minor textile picture, one piece.
Vintage psychedelic felt fibre-art wall hanging, Buy It Now from a US mid-century dealer. Outlier, not comparable to this unsigned group; shown only to mark the ceiling for strong designer pieces.
